paragraphs: R' Yirmeyah, son of R' Chiyya bar Abba.
Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 23:8, reporting with R' Berekhiah in the name of Levi bar Sisi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ויק״ר פכ״ג־ח is read as Vayikra Rabbah chapter 23 section 8, not a 23–8 range, without independently checked edition.

The compressed with-Berekhiah/in-Levi’s-name wording remains; it does not separately specify how the reporters relate, and no new chain edge is supplied. Levi has no title; the three personal title abbreviations remain R'.
